_comment: Nimbus collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed nimbus-cloud-nine` (since #24 collections may share lines; picks take never-used lines first), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_nimbus.py.

readme.title: Nimbus
readme.summary: Pokemon made of sky and cloud.
looks: each line wears one look: cumulus, fluffy white clouds on a blue sky (Lugia, Wailmer, Surskit); storm, a dark thunderhead with slanting rain and lightning (Tornadus, Druddigon, Scyther); sunset, clouds lit gold, pink and violet (Fezandipiti, Exeggcute, Remoraid); rain, grey clouds with raindrops falling down the body (Wishiwashi, Stunfisk, Arctovish); silver lining, dark clouds with shining silver edges (Type: Null, Glastrier, Inkay); cloud nine, pastel dream clouds with twinkling stars (Meloetta, Tapu Lele, Oshawott)
lightning strikes, rain falls, linings shine and stars twinkle in the dark; soft glowing eyes
shiny: the sky turned round the colour wheel
